_comment: Runnable (system-1) conformance spec for iv-rank, projected from .spire/clusters/tech/contracts/iv-rank/INTERFACE_CONTRACT.md '## Conformance spec' into the flat schema interface_conformance.py executes ({method,path,path_params,query,required}). Standalone convention (mirrors ai_context_pack.json / dealer-flow-projection.json / byo-ai-key / ai-rec-backtest-orders), NOT folded into another feature's spec. The feature's ONLY wire delta is the additive nested field market_state.iv_rank: the KEY is ALWAYS emitted on a post-feature backend, but its VALUE is OPTIONAL/NULLABLE by design (the market-data store starts EMPTY and grows -> most early reads are the 'building' state or null; a store outage / no-current-IV / read fault -> null; best-effort isolation). Every child is nullable too (rank is null in the degenerate-flat sub-case AND in building; percentile/band/current_iv are null in building). So the key is asserted as object|null (a null OR building cycle PASSES) and NO child/leaf path is required (asserting one would FAIL a legitimately-null best-effort cycle). The rest is the REGRESSION FLOOR the [additive-keeps-score-byte-identical] invariant demands: the additive field must not perturb the score/tier/gate/fingerprint path and market_state must stay the same envelope shape. The state-transition matrix (computed / computed-flat / building), the 70/30 band<->rank cut points, the self-describing envelope (window+sample-count+basis+advisory), byte-identity with-vs-without the field, and the null family are verified off-harness by the BE runtime proofs + the FE test matrix (UX_BLUEPRINT s5). RESUME gotcha: the /api/ticker dark_pool=true COLD path can exceed the tool's 30s timeout -> WARM the URL first within the 60s cache TTL (curl http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/ticker/SPY?min_dte=7&max_dte=45&dark_pool=true) then run; OR validate offline with --spec ... --sample <bundle.json> --endpoint "/api/ticker/{ticker}". Uses SPY (a liquid ticker; fetch once before running).
